It extends the glucose-insulin dynamics in blood model by a digestive compartment; h represents the net effect of all glucose-regulating hormones instead of insulin only.

blood glucose concentration analytical solution (analytical solution for the blood glucose concentration after glucose ingestion, for the underdamped case)

The analytical solution of the glucose-hormone model for the blood glucose concentration is fitted to glucose tolerance test data, i.e. blood glucose measured at several times after the intake of a glucose meal, separately for each person. The fasting blood glucose concentration, the decay parameter, the damped angular frequency, the amplitude of the ingestion-driven blood glucose disturbance and the time constant of the digestive system are estimated by the fit. The natural angular frequency and the natural time period are then computed from the fitted values. A natural time period below 4 hours indicates a normal person, a natural time period of 4 hours or more a pre-diabetic person.
